value: Firefighter recruits exposed to a functional fitness program had lower injury rates (11% vs. 54%) and fewer compensation claims than unexposed recruits.
quote: Recruits exposed to the functional fitness training program experienced significantly lower injury rates (11% vs. 54%; p = 0.009) and filed fewer workers compensation claims (13 claims totaling US $6679 vs. 55 claims totaling US $95,582; p = 0.028) than recruits who were not exposed to the program.
